jobs.occupation: Sales Manager – Polish Market | Based in Copenhagen area
jobs.description:
Are you based in Denmark, fluent in Polish, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Poland. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in Denmark to grow our customer base in Poland. You will combine your Polish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

Working from Denmark, you will be responsible for contacting restaurant customers in Poland. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Contacting potential customers in the Polish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and follow-ups. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Polish. 

• 
Managing the sales process from first contact to signed agreement. 

• 
Maintaining a structured and up-to-date pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers. 

What you bring 

• 
You are based in Denmark and want to work with the Polish market. 

• 
Fluency in Polish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 year of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses. 

What you can expect from us 

• 
A role based in Denmark with responsibility for sales in Poland. 

• 
An international team with strong commercial experience. 

• 
Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers. 

• 
The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Poland. 

• 
A supportive working environment with room for ideas and professional development. 

• 
A compensation package with a performance-based component. 

Interested? 

Send your application and CV in English. We would love to hear about your sales experience, your connection to the Polish market, and why you would like to join DinnerBooking.

Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

Team

The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

Role

The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• 
Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• 
Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• 
Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• 
Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• 
Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• 
Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• 
Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• 
Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• 
Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• 
Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• 
Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• 
Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

You

You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• 
Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• 
Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• 
Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• 
Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• 
Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.

CIP Fund Solutions

CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.

jobs.occupation: Consultant, CFO Services - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:
We aim to create futuristic financial departments by assisting businesses in analyzing, implementing, and supporting digital solutions. Would you like to help define what comes next? Supporting the CFO on a path to a more digitalized future is our finest duty. We are looking for consultants, ready to untangle financial knots, lighten the load for our clients and make their future simpler.

About the role

As a consultant in CFO Services, you’ll join a team focused on advancing finance through practical, innovative solutions. You’ll work closely with clients, colleagues, and the latest technologies to solve real challenges and deliver real impact.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Create tailored solutions using the latest digital tools and AI technologies to help clients optimize their finance functions.

• 
Collaborate across disciplines with experts in strategy, risk, compliance, and tech to deliver holistic solutions.

• 
Grow fast through practical experience, structured learning, and mentoring from experienced consultants.

Perks of joining CFO Services

At CFO Services, you won’t just be another consultant, you’ll be part of a close-knit team that’s redefining what it means to work in finance. We combine solid financial know-how with a focus on digital innovation, and we aim to improve how things are done.

We advise both private and public companies in enterprise performance management, process excellence, controls, risk and compliance, finance strategy and transformation, digital finance & finance operation.

We enjoy digging into data to uncover what’s really going on, and in CFO Services we are motivated by helping companies solve challenges that don’t come with a manual.

About you, our new team member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Possess strong analytical skills and an interest in solving financial and digital challenges.

• 
Is motivated by the potential of technology to transform finance functions through automation, reporting, and data-driven insights.

• 
Enjoys working with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams, and value building strong relationships.

• 
Takes ownership of your work and are motivated to continuously learn, develop, and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

• 
Thrives in a non-hierarchical culture with a high degree of responsibility and self-management.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, as required by our client portfolio.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

About the role

Would you like to be part of an ambitious Compliance team where you play a key role in ensuring that Saxo meets its regulatory obligations across all parts of the Information Communication Technology (ICT) organisation?

If so, this may be the right opportunity for you.

You will join the Prudential Oversight team within Group Compliance, Saxo's second line of defence function, based at our headquarters in Hellerup. The team oversees compliance risks across ICT, operational risk and data governance, supporting the business in meeting regulatory requirements, market standards and internal policies. Working closely with Compliance colleagues in Denmark and internationally, you will play a key role in strengthening compliance oversight across Saxo's technology organisation.

Your primary responsibility will be to conduct compliance oversight and monitoring across ICT areas regulated by DORA, including ICT risk management, incident management, business continuity and resilience testing, access management, critical functions and systems and third-party ICT service providers.

Depending on your profile, knowledge and experience, the role may also include compliance activities within operational risk, data quality and data governance.

As a team, we balance professionalism with a sense of humour and maintain an informal atmosphere where people enjoy coming to work.

Responsibilities

You will join an organisation where the foundation of the business is built on ICT and where platform availability is key to help clients get invested in the world. In the Prudential Oversight Compliance Team, ICT regulation is a core focus, and you will help us support Saxo in continuously driving this important area in a compliant direction.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Perform compliance risk assessments within the areas of ICT risks, operational risks and data risks, with a particular focus on DORA-related requirements

• 
Provide advice, challenge and compliance opinions to the business on regulatory requirements and compliance risks

• 
Conduct compliance monitoring activities, including follow-up and closure of recommendations

• 
Contribute to regular compliance reporting to the senior management of the bank

• 
Participate in developing Saxo’s compliance framework

• 
Collaborate closely with our Compliance Team in India

• 
Interact with the business across organisational levels and seniority

Your profile

We are looking for a colleague with solid experience working in ICT compliance, operational risk, data governance or technology risk management.

Most importantly, you have experience working with ICT requirements and legislation, ICT governance, risk assessments, and advisory work related to ICT requirements, and you are familiar with DORA or NIS2.

You may have gained this experience within a second line of defence compliance or risk function, a first line of defence risk or control role within financial services, internal or external audit, IT audit, consultancy or another highly regulated industry. Experience with operational risk and data governance is considered an advantage.

Moreover, we are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, can work independently while taking an active role in teamwork, and enjoys collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across the entire organisation.

It is an advantage if you thrive in an environment with constant change, bring a positive and curious mindset to work, and do not buy into the word ‘cannot’.

You must possess strong stakeholder management skills and use your communication skills to ensure positive collaboration and progress in joint tasks. We are looking for a colleague who always brings a positive attitude when liaising with the business.

About The Job

Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

Responsibilities

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

Your profile

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments

Nice to have:

• Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – IoT Platform, Load and Energy Management
jobs.description:
🚀 About the role

We're looking for a senior software engineer who writes solid, reliable code and wants that code to control real hardware. At FLEXECHARGE, our HARMON-E platform manages load and energy for EV charging operators across Europe. Part of it runs at the edge, on an industrial PC next to chargers, batteries and solar inverters, and connected to the interfaces DSOs use to curtail load.

You'll build and maintain the TypeScript microservices that talk to those devices and turn their data into decisions. This is not a web-app role. It's software engineering for systems where the other side is physical, stateful and often unreliable.

⚡ What is special about this role

It sits where two worlds meet:

• 
Web and cloud toolchain: TypeScript, Docker, MQTT, Azure, Kubernetes.

• 
Operational technology and system integration: talking to real chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus and OCPP, running at the edge on an industrial PC.

Your code won't only talk to clean APIs in a data centre. It runs on site, next to real peripheral devices, and has to keep doing its job when those devices and the networks between them don't behave as expected.

We recognize that TypeScript is not typically used for edge computing or hardware interfacing. This is why we're looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning new techniques and applications, as well as applying their technical skills in novel ways.

🛠️ What you'll do

• 
Write and maintain a combination of TypeScript microservices and the business logic behind them: control algorithms, scheduling and decision-making, not just plumbing.

• 
Build and extend device drivers for chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus TCP, using our existing driver services as a starting point.

• 
Work with OCPP, which our platform already supports, as you ramp up.

• 
Run services in containers at the edge and connect them through MQTT and pub/sub messaging to our cloud backend.

• 
Profile and optimise software on edge hardware, where hardware resources are constrained.

• 
Help shape the long-term move of performance-critical services to compiled languages.

• 
Mentor and pair with colleagues on integrations and software craft.

🤔 Why compiled languages, if we write TypeScript?

It may sound odd, so here's the reasoning. Today the majority of our edge stack is TypeScript, and you'll develop in it from day one. Over time we want to move selected services, such as device interfaces and performance-critical paths, to a compiled language while keeping them part of the same stack.

To do that well, you need to understand both sides: the TypeScript services as they are now, and the concepts of memory, types and performance that compiled languages force you to think about. In our experience, it's much easier to go from a compiled language to a scripting environment than the other way around. So if you're a Go, C, C++, Rust or similar developer who is happy to work in TypeScript (or happy to learn), you're exactly who we're looking for.

✅ Must-have

• 
3–5+ years of professional software development, with strong software and engineering fundamentals.

• 
Professional experience in a compiled language (for example Go, C, C++, Rust, C# or Java).

• 
Proficiency in a scripting language, ideally TypeScript, otherwise JavaScript or Python, or a clear willingness to become productive in TypeScript quickly.

• 
Experience writing business logic with stateful calculations and operations, which can self-heal and recover gracefully.

• 
Comfort with asynchronous and event-driven systems that talk to unreliable external components or peripheral devices.

💡 Strongly preferred (but we'll teach it)

• 
Hands-on device or protocol integration: Modbus, serial interfaces, Ethernet/TCP-IP or comparable.

• 
Containerised applications. Docker, Docker Compose or Kubernetes are ideal, but any container technology counts.

• 
Pub/sub and distributed systems, ideally MQTT or another IoT messaging protocol, and an understanding of their reliability concerns.

• 
Working within constrained systems, including profiling software to find where CPU or memory limits bite.

🎁 Bonus, not a requirement

• 
OCPP experience.

• 
Energy, EV charging or power-systems domain knowledge.

• 
Edge deployment experience.

If you don't have these, apply anyway. Strong fundamentals and the right mindset matter more. 💪

🚫 This role is probably not for you if

• 
Your experience is mainly frontend or request/response web apps, with no compiled-language background.

• 
You prefer to stay in one language and aren't interested in working in TypeScript.

• 
You want a pure firmware or PLC role without writing higher-level services.

• 
You don't enjoy debugging the messy cases where hardware doesn't behave as documented.

🌆 What is it like to work at FLEXECHARGE?

• 
Our office is in Frederiksberg: bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday.

• 
You're covered with pension contributions.

• 
Lunch is served on-site, and it's delicious, healthy and nutritious.

• 
We enjoy each other's company outside work too, with Friday bars, company events and team-building activities within each team.

• 
You'll have opportunities for individual development.

🤝 Our interview process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• 
A first conversation (about 30 minutes) with our recruiter. You'll get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further.

• 
Time with the team: a conversation with Kasper, our Head of Architecture & Systems, and Robert, our CTO.

• 
A technical stage: one or more interviews with the team, which may include a case exercise and follow-up discussions. These can take place remotely or at our office.

• 
A conversation with Max, our CEO, alongside someone else from the team.

Hiring carefully matters to us. We want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you.

📍 Location & practical details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen. Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• 
We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

• 
We do not offer relocation services.

🔐 Data privacy (GDPR)

Applications for this role are processed exclusively through The Hub (thehub.io), our recruitment platform, in accordance with their privacy policy and applicable GDPR requirements. As part of our interview process, conversations may be recorded and transcribed via Microsoft Teams, and AI tools may be used to summarise interview notes to support our hiring team's evaluation. Your data will be handled confidentially, retained only during the interview process, and used only for this recruitment process.

For more information or questions please contact us at iva@flexecharge.com

Working at

FLEXECHARGE

FLEXECHARGE is a cleantech scale-up which offers a powerful load & energy management platform, as a SaaS, to help Charge Point Operators (ex: Clever, eOn, etc.) to optimise their charging operations & business. Our mission is accelerate green mobility through our Smart Charging solutions that make charging faster, greener and cheaper. Our vision is to integrate charging infrastructures better with the grid supply and the ever more volatile & growing production of renewable energy. We want to connect electric vehicles with the grid in a whole new way. By seeing electric vehicles not as a risk for our supply grid, but as a crucial asset for the transition towards 100% renewable energy. We do this through constant innovation of new smart charging features which will make us the preferred partner for EV infrastructure owners, developers, and operators.

• Support ad hoc analyses, board materials, and special projects for the Partners and senior team members

**You

**We are looking for a motivated and collaborative professional with a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline, combined with approximately 2-4 years of relevant experience from investment banking, private equity, management consulting, corporate finance, or a similar analytical environment.

CIP offers an international, intellectually stimulating, and high-performance environment. We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and analytical professional who is focused on developing themselves within strategic investments and capital allocation.

**Key qualifications include:

**

• Strong financial and strategic acumen, with solid valuation, investment analysis, and financial modelling skills

• Experience supporting transaction processes, due diligence, and investment-related analyses

• Ability to structure complex problems and evaluate opportunities and risks across a range of scenarios, with solid numerical skills and attention to detail

• Skilled in project management, with experience overseeing processes, bringing stakeholders together, and tracking multiple workstreams

• Experience with, or interest in, negotiating commercial and legal terms

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency, with the ability to produce high-quality decision materials

• Interest in fund structures, GP/LP dynamics, and infrastructure or renewable energy investments is an advantage

• A proactive and structured approach, with ownership of deliverables and the motivation to move projects forward

• Skilled at building productive relationships and collaborating across teams and functions

• Excellent written and verbal English skills

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist for CMC Oral Drug Product Development
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Oral Drug Products

Do you want to turn your process development expertise into meaningful scientific impact? As our new Senior Scientist, you will help shape Novo*s future oral pipeline and contribute directly to high-priority projects with the potential to become tomorrow’s key medicines.

Working with modern equipment and advanced technologies in tablet development and manufacturing, you will drive innovation, deepen your expertise, and take significant scientific ownership in an area experiencing strong growth and investment. You will support both early- and late-stage development projects with your expertise in oral drug product process development.

This is an opportunity to take the next step in your career while advancing some of the most strategically important products in our oral portfolio. Ready to make your mark on the future of oral drug development? Join us in Chemistry, Manufacturing and Control (CMC) Drug Product Development. Apply today!

What you’ll do

As our new Senior Scientist, you will play a key role you will play a key role in driving process development to secure optimal pharmaceutical characteristics and product stability. You will take scientific ownership across one or more oral drug product projects and strengthen knowledge sharing across the portfolio.

Your impact and responsibilities:

• Set the scientific direction for designing, interpreting and reporting development studies.

• Be responsible for developing and transferring processes suitable for GMP production for clinical studies (phase I, II and III)

• Combine your process and drug product understanding to make conclusions about the next step in the drug product projects.

• Own end‑to‑end process by defining documentation strategies for internal and external purposes.

• Collaborate widely with internal stakeholders, including Global Research, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance and Analytical Development.

• Strengthen knowledge sharing by working closely with scientists, lab technicians and specialists to plan and execute studies on drug products.

You will be expected to set a clear scientific direction, identify opportunities, and inspire colleagues to move projects forward.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you hold a Master’s degree or PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, engineering, or another relevant natural science discipline. You also bring:

• At least 3 years of experience in CMC, R&D, or drug product development across phases I–III.

• Experience with powder technology, tablet formulation, tablet manufacturing, and/or finished drug products.

• Familiarity with phase-appropriate quality expectations and documentation.

• An innovative, proactive, and engaging mindset that helps move projects forward.

• Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills in a multi-stakeholder environment.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

On a personal level, you combine collaboration with the confidence to lead your own area of responsibility. You adapt well in a dynamic environment and can communicate complex scientific topics clearly to colleagues and stakeholders with different backgrounds, building support for your ideas and recommendations.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

In CMC Drug Product Development, we develop formulations and manufacturing processes for oral and injectable biopharmaceutical products. We are approximately 200 employees organised across eleven teams in Måløv. Our projects span early development in phases I–II through late-stage development and process validation in phase III.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that, In CMC Drug Product Development we foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

What we offer

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Please apply by 25 October 2026. We review applications and interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so apply early, as the position may close before the deadline.

For further information, please contact Sigurd Greve Dideriksen at +45 3448 4498 or Søren Vinter Søgaard at +45 3448 7751.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in CMC Drug Product Development. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Do you thrive on bringing stories and events to life through high-quality video and live productions? We're looking for an experienced Producer to join our Video & Live Production team at Novo. Working closely with colleagues, stakeholders and external partners.

You will plan, direct and deliver impactful live, hybrid and recorded productions while ensuring technical excellence from concept to execution.

Your new role

Your main responsibilities will be:

• Lead the planning, direction and delivery of high-quality live, hybrid and recorded productions, ensuring engaging experiences for audiences across Novo.

• Direct live broadcasts from the gallery and take on additional production roles when needed, ensuring smooth execution from preparation to delivery.

• Design and implement technical production setups, broadcast workflows and visual concepts, including studios, scenery and graphics.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to transform communication objectives into compelling, audience-focused productions that maximise engagement and impact.

• Advise colleagues and internal clients on the most effective production formats, visual approaches and technical solutions to support clear and effective communication.

• Coach hosts, presenters and contributors, helping them feel confident and perform effectively on camera.

• Support production planning, coordination and budgeting, while contributing to off-site productions and post-production editing activities.

You will work across our production facilities in Søborg, Bagsværd and Måløv, with Søborg as your primary workplace. Our facilities include professional green screen studios, gallery environments, a modern auditorium featuring a 17-metre LED screen, and mobile production setups that support both on-site and off-site productions.

While this role is primarily performed during regular Monday-to-Friday business hours, occasional evening work may be required.

Your new department

You will join a team of 23 colleagues specializing in video, broadcast and live production who support communication across the entire Novo organization.

Together, you create engaging experiences through live events, town halls, leadership communication, brand videos, documentaries, webinars, hybrid productions and other strategic communication initiatives.

Your closest collaborators will include fellow producers, technical specialists, communicators, internal stakeholders and external production partners. Working across sites in Søborg, Bagsværd and Måløv, you will help bring ideas to life through a combination of creative storytelling, technical expertise and seamless production delivery.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a professional broadcast environment with access to modern production facilities and technologies, while benefiting from more predictable working hours than are typically found in traditional TV and media production. You will have the chance to develop both your creative and technical expertise while contributing to communication that reaches colleagues across Novo.

Your skills and qualifications

You bring at least five years of experience from professional live TV or broadcast production environments and combine a strong creative eye with hands-on technical expertise. You are comfortable working with both technology and people, translating communication objectives into engaging productions and explaining technical concepts clearly to colleagues with different backgrounds.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• 5+ years of experience in live TV, broadcast or live production environments

• Experience with live production workflows, video routing, signal flow, studio infrastructure and troubleshooting

• Solid understanding of IT systems, networking fundamentals and IP-based broadcast workflows and technologies

• Experience with video editing, preferably using Adobe Creative Cloud, as well as studio and stage lighting

• Ability to translate creative and communication needs into compelling visual productions and build strong relationships with stakeholders

• Professional proficiency in English

• Experience with ROSS video switchers and routers, Unreal Engine, CasparCG, SMPTE ST 2110 and AI tools is considered an advantage

You are structured, hands-on and solution-oriented, and you remain calm during live productions. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with others. With a service-oriented mindset, you are comfortable supporting presenters and contributors with varying levels of on-camera experience while sharing your creative and technical expertise with colleagues.

Working at Novo

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600.00 to 734,400.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Sr Manager, Bolette Fogh at +45 3017 2957. Please be advised Bolette will not support queries about your recruitment status.

Deadline

October 28th, 2026

Applications will be reviewed, and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. Therefore, do not hesitate to apply if interested at your earliest convenience.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Your impact begins here

As Principal Clinical Pharmacology Specialist, you will lead clinical pharmacology programmes and set the clinical pharmacology strategy for early and late-stage development projects across our growing cardiometabolic portfolio. From trial design and first-in-human dose setting to regulatory submissions, your scientific insight will shape how new drugs move through development. Your work helps turn science into treatments that create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

To thrive and succeed in this role, you will have:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, supported by a PhD or equivalent scientific expertise.

• Expert knowledge of clinical pharmacology gained within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• A strong scientific and strategic mindset, combined with a solid understanding of clinical dosing, including first-in-human dose setting and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) relationships.

• A proven track record of planning and conducting clinical trials, as well as working in cross-functional, global and dynamic environments.

• Experience in interactions with Health Authorities.

• A strong understanding of the business and the wider value chain.

• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate as a trustworthy team player, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and manage priorities and deadlines with a strong focus on quality.

• The independence, initiative and drive to succeed in a fast-paced, high-performing environment, combined with an innovative, patient-centric and strategic approach.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken English.

What you’ll do

You will be accountable for the clinical pharmacology strategy of your projects and bring clinical pharmacology expertise to every stage of development, from early trials to submission.

• Lead clinical pharmacology programmes and provide the clinical pharmacology strategy for early and late-stage development projects.

• Provide clinical pharmacology expertise to development project teams, including clinical pharmacology trial design and the interpretation and communication of trial results.

• Drive and coordinate activities within headquarters-based study groups, collaborating with affiliates and external partners across the value chain.

• Lead scientific communication and engage with a wide range of internal and external global stakeholders, including key opinion leaders.

• Prepare clinical pharmacology summaries for submission dossiers and interact with Health Authorities, providing input that supports regulatory approvals for new drugs.

• Strengthen Clinical Pharmacology capabilities through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

Who you’ll work with

In Research & Development, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. You will join the Clinical Pharmacology organisation, made up of five Clinical Pharmacology departments and an integrated part of Medical and Translational Sciences.

Clinical Pharmacology works as part of development and research project teams. The organisation is responsible for the clinical pharmacology strategy and the scientific input to clinical pharmacology trials, and provides expertise to all clinical development phases, Health Authority interactions and regulatory submissions worldwide.

Your closest partners will be development project teams and headquarters-based study groups. You will also work with affiliates, external partners across the value chain, key opinion leaders and Health Authorities – bringing perspectives together so decisions are clear and projects keep their momentum.

What you can expect here

You will join dedicated and highly engaged colleagues in a flexible, collaborative and cross-functional setting. Your expertise will be trusted, and your voice will count in shaping the clinical pharmacology strategy of the projects you lead.

Additionally, you will help others grow, sharing your knowledge and mentoring colleagues to build Clinical Pharmacology capabilities. In return, you will broaden your own perspective through close work across the development value chain and with global stakeholders.

Our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape clinical pharmacology strategy that moves new drugs forward, apply for the Principal Clinical Pharmacology Specialist role by 25 October 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
